name: Dialog
description: Centered modal for confirmation, alerts, and short tasks on mobile and desktop.

figma.notes: No standalone Figma binding is assigned yet.

open.description: Controlled visibility. Closed dialogs unmount their content.

title.description: Visible heading and accessible dialog name.

closeLabel.description: Localized accessible label for the default variant's close action.

onClose.description: Request to close; the consumer must set open to false.

role.description: Use alertdialog only for critical prompts that need immediate announcement.

variant.description: Confirmation centers its title and relies on explicit footer actions instead of a close button.

footer.description: Caller-owned actions outside the scrolling content.

focus.note: Uses Button focus rings, confines Tab navigation, and restores the opener on close.

tapTarget.note: The visual close control is 32px with a centered 20px icon and Button's 44px hit-area extender.

accessibility.ariaPattern: Native modal dialog labelled by its visible h2; alertdialog is an explicit variant.
accessibility.interaction: showModal makes the background inert. Focus starts on Close for default dialogs or the first control for confirmation dialogs, remains inside, and returns to the opener.
